overview: Adaptive Practice Question Recommendation addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in education and research operations. The first proof of value uses curriculum objectives, learner attempts and teacher rubrics. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is mastery improvement on matched pre/post test, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: mastery improvement on matched pre/post test

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: curriculum objectives, learner attempts and teacher rubrics; define mastery improvement on matched pre/post test and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from University CIO / Academic Program Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for mastery improvement on matched pre/post test
